laws.rule: Mount Etna's summit area is divided into a Summit Zone (around the summit craters and generally above 2,500 m) and, inside it, a Permanent Hazard Zone around the active craters, where access is always under specific safety rules. When Sicily's civil protection department declares the pre-alarm phase the Permanent Hazard Zone is closed; at the alarm phase the whole Summit Zone is closed. The access rules themselves are set by mayoral ordinances of the towns around the volcano.
